description: Parse quirks: untrimmed keys and values, a header with a trailing space switching tracking off, an @ByteArray( without its ')', an empty gamePath (Path('.')), empty and quoted/escaped CSV values, %BASE_DIR% with and without a separator, and a relative directory.

deviations.reason: The port replaces %BASE_DIR% in a directory value with the base directory as MO2 does, so %BASE_DIR%/mods is <base>\mods, not the drive root.
